title: Week 2 Application Check-In
subtitle: Use this week's ideas to understand a real recovery experience.
description: This is not a memory test. Explaining an idea in your own words and applying it to your life helps make the learning useful.

sections.title: Explain it simply
sections.description: Imagine you are explaining the idea to a friend.

fields.label: Why can symptoms change without automatically meaning that new damage has occurred?
How is pacing different from avoiding activity?
fields.placeholder: Describe how pacing can support gradual progress...

sections.title: Apply it to this week
sections.description: Look for one real pattern rather than a perfect answer.

fields.label: Describe one symptom change or difficult day. What else was happening around it?
fields.placeholder: Consider activity, recovery time, sleep, stress, expectations, illness, workload, or anything else relevant...

fields.label: What response helped—or what might you try next time?
fields.placeholder: A flare-up strategy, activity adjustment, manageable movement, support, or appropriate assessment...

sections.title: Choose one experiment
sections.description: Use a small test to learn what supports your recovery.

fields.label: One activity or sleep-support experiment I will try:
What will I observe?
fields.placeholder: Function, confidence, consistency, energy, symptoms, or participation...

fields.label: Is there anything I want to discuss with my practitioner?
fields.placeholder: A concern, question, pattern, or useful win...

successMessage: Week 2 complete. You are turning general recovery concepts into information you can use.
